title: Semi-discrete Optimal Transport for Time-Varying Multi-Agent Coverage Control
summary: Coverage control algorithms have traditionally focused on static target densities, where agents optimally cover a fixed spatial distribution. However, many applications, such as environmental monitoring, surveillance, and adaptive sensing, involve time-varying densities. While time-varying coverage has been studied in Voronoi-based frameworks, extending recent optimal transport formulations of static coverage control to time-varying target densities remains an open problem.
